messages:
alex: Proposal: opt-in preflight for /v1/embeddings that returns a cheap shape hint + estimated units instead of hard-rejects. Improve UX for mixed-dim clients and enable console previews.
anya: Opt-in only. gzip/binary framing can be ambiguous; don't add default latency.
mike: header X-Embed-Preflight: 1 or ?preflight=true. Fastpath only (<=5ms) inspect first 1KB heuristics.
kai: telemetry: preflight.latency_ms, preflight.suggest_rate, preflight.mismatch_rate, preflight.estimated_units. retention 90d dashboard, 13mo billing histograms.
alex: API returns small JSON + headers: X-Embed-Shape, X-Embed-Units, X-Embed-Preflight-Version. For mixed dims include suggested_split and split_policy hint.
anya: SDKs can auto-retry with suggested split.
mike: ensure preflight counts against auth/quota; also add low rate cap to avoid fingerprinting.
kai: dashboard widgets: per-tenant suggest rate, estimate histogram, preflight->final mismatch. Gate rollout by p95 latency and false_suggest_rate.
opsbot: deploybot: created flag ingress.preflight_v1 at 5% canary.
alex: I'll draft RFC with contract + rollout. mike owns fastpath, kai owns console tile. Follow-up in RFC thread.
